app.subtitle: Choose a room and a time that works for your team. We will flag conflicts before you submit.
app.tagline: A focused workspace for fast, conflict-free room reservations.

rooms.emptyDescription: There are no bookable rooms configured yet. Please check back later.
rooms.chooseDescription: Select the space that fits your meeting. Times are shown in each room’s timezone.

booking.title: Book a room
booking.formDescription: Pick a start and end time. Your request will be checked for conflicts automatically.
booking.submitHint: You can review conflict suggestions before confirming.
booking.submitFailed: Booking could not be submitted. Check your connection and try again.

errors.authorizationRequired: You must be signed in to book a room.
errors.notAuthorized: You are not authorized to book a room.
